en: liquid analgesic patch-lotion; topical pain-relief liquid

examples.en: I got a mosquito bite, so I put liquid pain reliever on it.
It stings if the liquid pain reliever gets in your eyes.
Liquid pain reliever feels cool when you apply it.
I bought a bottle of liquid pain reliever at the pharmacy.
There is also liquid pain reliever in Mom's drawer.
I rubbed the insect bite with liquid pain reliever.

explain: 붙이는 '파스'와 달리 액체를 발라서 쓰는 약이에요. 어깨가 뻐근할 때나 벌레 물린 곳에 쓰는 경우가 많아요.

phrases.en: My shoulder hurt, so I put on liquid pain reliever.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 흔하게 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common collocation.

phrases.en: The room smells like liquid pain reliever.
phrases.nuance_ko: 약의 강한 냄새를 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for the strong smell of the medicine.

phrases.en: I packed liquid pain reliever for the trip.
phrases.nuance_ko: 나가기 전에 필요한 물건을 가방에 넣어 준비한다는 뜻으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means getting something you need ready and putting it in your bag before going out.

explain_en: Unlike the adhesive '파스' patch, this is a liquid you rub on. People often use it for stiff shoulders or insect bites.

examples.ko: 이 크림은 미백 효과가 있다고 해요.
examples.en: They say this cream has a whitening effect.
I am looking for a product whose purpose is whitening.
I booked the dentist for teeth whitening.

examples.ko: 미백 기능이 있는 화장품은 자외선 차단도 중요해요.
examples.en: For cosmetics with a whitening function, sun protection matters too.

examples.ko: 미백에 좋다는 과일 주스를 마셔 봤어요.
examples.en: I tried a fruit juice said to be good for whitening.

examples.ko: 미백 관리는 꾸준히 하는 게 중요해요.
examples.en: It is important to keep up whitening care steadily.

explain: 광고와 제품 이름에 자주 나오는 말이에요. '미백 크림', '치아 미백'처럼 명사로 붙여 쓰고, 일상 대화에서는 '하얘지다', '하얗게 하다'를 더 많이 써요. 피부와 치아에 쓰는 말이라 옷이나 벽에는 쓰지 않아요.

phrases.en: I went to the pharmacy to buy a whitening cream.
phrases.nuance_ko: 피부 제품 이름으로 가장 흔해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common skin-product name.

phrases.en: I want to get my teeth whitened.
phrases.nuance_ko: 치아를 하얗게 하는 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for making teeth whiter.

phrases.en: Whitening products are popular these days.
phrases.nuance_ko: 크림, 치약 같은 여러 제품을 함께 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to refer to products such as creams and toothpaste together.

explain_en: It appears often in ads and product names. It attaches as a noun, like 미백 크림 and 치아 미백, while everyday talk uses 하얘지다 or 하얗게 하다. It is for skin and teeth, so it is not used for clothes or walls.

examples.en: I have a lot of dandruff, so I changed my shampoo.

examples.ko: 비듬 때문에 검은 옷을 입기가 불편해요.
examples.en: Because of dandruff, wearing black clothes is uncomfortable.

examples.ko: 겨울에는 두피가 건조해서 비듬을 더 신경 써요.
examples.en: In winter my scalp is dry, so I pay more attention to dandruff.

examples.ko: 비듬은 자주 감아도 없어지지 않을 때가 있어요.
examples.en: Sometimes dandruff does not go away even if you wash often.
Please recommend a shampoo that is good for dandruff.
I was embarrassed because even white dandruff was visible on my shoulders.

explain: 머리 피부에서 하얗게 떨어지는 것을 말하고, '비듬이 생기다', '비듬이 떨어지다'처럼 자주 말해요. 약국이나 마트에서는 '비듬 샴푸'라는 말도 볼 수 있어요.

phrases.en: Dandruff easily forms on my scalp in winter.
phrases.nuance_ko: 비듬이 처음 나타날 때 쓰는 기본 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The basic expression for when dandruff first appears.

phrases.en: Dandruff falls on my shoulders and it bothers me.
phrases.nuance_ko: 옷 위로 비듬이 보일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when dandruff can be seen on clothes.

phrases.en: I bought dandruff shampoo at the pharmacy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 상품 이름처럼 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A collocation often used like a product name.

explain_en: It refers to the white flakes that come off the scalp, and it is often used as '비듬이 생기다' or '비듬이 떨어지다'. At pharmacies and stores you may also see '비듬 샴푸'.

examples.en: I had a headache, so I took an aspirin.

examples.ko: 이 약은 아스피린이 아니라 다른 약이에요.
examples.en: This medicine is not aspirin but a different one.
I bought a bottle of aspirin at the pharmacy.
There is aspirin in my backpack, but no bandage.
The first aid kit has aspirin in it too.
Some people are allergic to aspirin.

explain: '진통제'는 아픔을 줄이는 약을 두루 부르는 이름이고, 아스피린은 그중 하나의 약 이름이에요. 약은 '먹다'와 같이 쓰고, 어른께는 '드시다'라고 해요. 병원에서 받는 약은 '처방약'이라고 해요.

phrases.example: 열이 나서 아스피린 한 알을 먹었어요.
phrases.en: I had a fever, so I took one aspirin.
phrases.nuance_ko: 약은 '알'로 세요.
phrases.nuance_en: Pills are counted with '알'.

phrases.en: I bought aspirin at the pharmacy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 약국에서 약을 살 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use this when buying medicine at a pharmacy.

phrases.en: I have painkillers like aspirin at home.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아스피린을 진통제의 한 예로 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use this to give aspirin as one example of a painkiller.

explain_en: '진통제' is the general name for medicine that reduces pain, and 아스피린 is one specific medicine among them. Medicine goes with '먹다', and for an elder you say '드시다'. Medicine from a hospital prescription is '처방약'.

examples.en: I had a formal outfit made to wear to the wedding.
Soldiers wear dress uniforms at ceremonies.

examples.ko: 예복은 평소 옷보다 단정하고 격식이 있어요.
examples.en: Formal wear is neater and more formal than everyday clothes.
I only wear this formal outfit at graduations.

examples.ko: 예복 때문에 너무 더워서 땀이 났어요.
examples.en: The formal clothes made me so hot that I sweated.
What is the difference between a suit and formal wear?

explain: 예복은 결혼식, 졸업식, 공식 행사처럼 격식 있는 자리에서 입는 옷이에요. '정장'은 직장에서도 입지만 예복은 특별한 행사 때 입어서 더 무거운 느낌이에요. 신부가 입는 옷은 '웨딩드레스', 신랑이 입는 옷은 '턱시도'나 '예복'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I wore formal dress at the graduation ceremony.
phrases.nuance_ko: 격식 있는 자리에 갈 때 가장 기본으로 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic phrase for dressing for a formal occasion.

phrases.en: I rented formal clothes to wear to the wedding.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사지 않고 잠깐 빌려 입을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when borrowing or renting rather than buying.

phrases.en: Everyone came to the event in formal dress.
phrases.nuance_ko: 예복을 입은 모습을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes how someone looks when dressed in formal wear.

explain_en: 예복 is clothing for formal occasions such as weddings, graduations and official events. A '정장' (suit) can be worn to work too, but 예복 is for special events, so it feels heavier. A bride's outfit is a '웨딩드레스', and a groom's is a '턱시도' or '예복'.

examples.en: The stain is removed cleanly.
Ads were removed from the app.

examples.ko: 제거된 파일은 다시 볼 수 없어요.
examples.en: Removed files cannot be seen again.
I wait until the danger is removed.
Harmful germs are being eliminated.
The problem was eliminated, so I feel at ease.

explain: 더럽거나 위험하거나 필요 없는 것이 없어질 때 써요. '없어지다'보다 방법이 있어서 사라졌다는 느낌이 있어요. 짝말은 '제거하다'와 '추가되다'예요.

phrases.en: The virus was completely removed.
phrases.nuance_ko: '완전히'를 붙이면 하나도 남지 않고 없어졌다는 뜻이 강해져요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 'completely' stresses that nothing was left behind.

phrases.en: This stain doesn't come off easily.
phrases.nuance_ko: 없애려고 했는데 아직 남아 있을 때 부정형으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The negative form is used when something is still there despite an attempt to remove it.

phrases.en: The unnecessary content has already been removed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 제거된 결과가 지금 그대로 있다는 상태를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes the current state that results from something having been removed.

explain_en: Used when something dirty, dangerous or unneeded disappears. It suggests removal by some method, more than simply vanishing. Related words are the active verb and the passive of adding.

examples.en: After the surgery, my grandfather is in the intensive care unit.

examples.ko: 중환자실에는 가족도 마음대로 들어갈 수 없어요.
examples.en: Even family cannot enter the ICU freely.
He was badly hurt in a traffic accident and moved to the ICU.
The nurse stayed in the ICU all night.
Fortunately, he came out of the ICU two days later.

examples.ko: 드라마 속 중환자실 장면을 보고 눈물이 났어요.
examples.en: I cried watching the ICU scene in the drama.

explain: '중환자실로 옮기다', '중환자실에 들어가다'처럼 쓰면 자연스러워요. 일반 병실은 '병실'이고, 아주 급한 환자가 가는 응급 진료 공간은 '응급실'이라서 서로 달라요. 'ICU'라는 영어 이름도 병원에서 같이 써요.

phrases.en: They moved the patient to the ICU.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병이 심해져서 자리를 바꿀 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a patient is moved because their condition is serious.

phrases.en: My father went into the ICU yesterday.
phrases.nuance_ko: 치료를 위해 그곳에 있게 된다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means to be placed there for treatment.

phrases.en: At hospitals, the intensive care unit is also called the ICU.
phrases.nuance_ko: 중환자실의 영어 이름이고 병원에서 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The English name for the unit, also used in hospitals.

explain_en: 중환자실로 옮기다 and 중환자실에 들어가다 sound natural. An ordinary room is a 병실, and the place for urgent emergency care is the 응급실, so they are different. Hospitals also use the English name ICU.

en: to apply a hot pack; to apply a cold pack

examples.ko: 목욕탕에서 한 시간 동안 찜질을 했어요.
examples.en: I spent an hour doing a hot compress at the bathhouse.

examples.ko: 허리가 아플 때는 따뜻하게 찜질하면 도움이 돼요.
examples.en: When your back hurts, a warm compress helps.

examples.ko: 뭉친 근육이 풀리게 뜨거운 물수건으로 찜질했어요.
examples.en: I used a hot wet towel as a compress to loosen the tight muscle.
Please put an ice pack on the bruise.
My shoulder was stiff, so I used a hot pack and went to sleep.

examples.ko: 찜질하는 동안 책을 읽으면 시간이 빨리 가요.
examples.en: If you read a book while using a compress, time passes quickly.

explain: 뜨거운 것을 대면 '온찜질', 차가운 것을 대면 '냉찜질'이에요. '찜질을 하다'로도 자주 말하고, 한국식 사우나 시설은 '찜질방'이라고 해요.

phrases.example: 배가 아플 때 온찜질을 하면 좋아요.
phrases.en: A hot pack is good when your stomach hurts.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜨거운 것을 대는 찜질이에요. 근육이 뭉쳤을 때 자주 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pack treatment using something warm, often done for tight muscles.

phrases.en: When you sprain your ankle, you apply a cold pack.
phrases.nuance_ko: 차가운 것을 대는 찜질이에요. 다치거나 열이 날 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pack treatment using something cold, used for injuries or fever.

phrases.en: I went to a jjimjilbang with a friend on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국식 사우나 시설로, 뜨거운 방에서 쉬는 곳이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A Korean-style sauna facility where you relax in hot rooms.

explain_en: Applying something hot is '온찜질' and applying something cold is '냉찜질'. People often say it as '찜질을 하다', and the Korean-style sauna facility is called a '찜질방'.

examples.en: My younger sister knitted a scarf with wool yarn.
Grandmother is knitting with wool yarn.

examples.ko: 문구점에서 빨간 털실을 두 뭉치 샀어요.
examples.en: I bought two balls of red yarn at the stationery store.
The cat is playing with a ball of yarn.
The yarn is tangled, and it's really hard to untangle.
My head feels warm when I wear a yarn hat.

explain: 뜨개질에 쓰는 양털 같은 실이고, 보통 '털실로 짜다/뜨다'처럼 말해요. 실 한 덩어리는 '뭉치'나 '타래'로 세어요. 일상에서는 그냥 '실'이라고 하기도 하지만 털로 만든 실은 '털실'이라고 해야 정확해요.

phrases.en: I bought a ball of yarn at the market.
phrases.nuance_ko: 실 덩어리는 '뭉치'로 세요.
phrases.nuance_en: A lump of yarn is counted with '뭉치'.

phrases.en: I tried knitting gloves with yarn.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜨개질로 물건을 만들 때 '뜨다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use '뜨다' for making things by knitting.

phrases.en: It's warm when I wear a knit hat.
phrases.nuance_ko: 털실로 짠 물건 앞에 붙여 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Placed before items made of knitted wool.

explain_en: This is wool-like yarn used for knitting, and people say '털실로 짜다/뜨다'. One lump of it is counted as a '뭉치' or '타래'. In daily talk people may just say '실', but yarn made of wool is precisely '털실'.

examples.en: If you add chili oil, the broth gets spicier and sharper.

examples.ko: 고추기름이 있으면 볶음 요리가 훨씬 맛있어요.
examples.en: With chili oil, stir-fried dishes taste much better.

examples.ko: 이 짬뽕은 고추기름 때문에 색이 빨개요.
examples.en: This jjamppong is red because of the chili oil.
If you fry garlic in chili oil, it smells great.
Does the mart near your home sell chili oil?

examples.ko: 너무 맵지 않게 고추기름은 조금만 넣어 주세요.
examples.en: Please add just a little chili oil so it's not too spicy.

explain: 짬뽕, 마파두부 같은 중국식 요리에 자주 나와요. 고춧가루와 달리 기름에 매운맛과 붉은 색이 우러난 것이라서 국물 위에 빨갛게 떠 있어요.

phrases.en: Drizzle red pepper oil in the pan and stir-fry the vegetables.
phrases.nuance_ko: 요리할 때 기름을 팬에 조금 붓는 것을 '두르다'라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '두르다' means to pour a little oil into a pan when cooking.

phrases.en: Shrimp tastes good when stir-fried in red pepper oil.
phrases.nuance_ko: 재료를 고추기름으로 볶을 때 '-에 볶다'로 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Say '-에 볶다' when frying ingredients in red pepper oil.
phrases.en_equiv: to stir-fry in red pepper oil

phrases.en: I made red pepper oil at home with chili powder.
phrases.nuance_ko: 고춧가루와 기름으로 직접 만들 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: You can make it yourself from chili powder and oil.

explain_en: It often appears in Chinese-style dishes such as jjamppong and mapo tofu. Unlike chili powder, the heat and red color are infused into the oil, so it floats red on top of the broth.

examples.ko: 이 생선은 뼈가 연해서 발라내지 않고 먹어도 돼요.
examples.en: This fish has soft bones, so you can eat it without removing them.

examples.ko: 아이를 위해 생선 가시를 꼼꼼히 발라냈어요.
examples.en: I carefully picked the bones out of the fish for the child.
I take the bones out of the chicken and stir-fry only the meat.
Peeling off the shrimp shells is a hassle.

examples.ko: 가시를 발라내 주시면 더 잘 먹을 것 같아요.
examples.en: If you pick out the bones for me, I think I'll eat better.
I bought only meat with the rib bones taken out.

explain: 뼈, 가시, 껍데기를 떼어 내고 먹을 살만 남길 때 써요. 생선, 고기, 새우나 게에 어울리고, '생선 살을 발라 먹다'처럼 '발라'만 쓰기도 해요.

phrases.en: I remove the bones from the fish and eat it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 생선 먹을 때 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common phrase when eating fish.

phrases.en: I picked the meat out of the crab.
phrases.nuance_ko: 껍데기에서 먹을 살만 떼어 낼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when separating the edible meat.

phrases.en: Mom picked the bones out of the fish for me.
phrases.nuance_ko: 남을 위해 해 줄 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when doing it for someone else.

explain_en: Used when you remove bones, fish bones or shells and keep only the edible meat. It suits fish, meat, shrimp and crab, and people often use just '발라', as in '생선 살을 발라 먹다'.

examples.ko: 돈가스를 만들 때 고기에 빵가루를 묻혀요.
examples.en: When making pork cutlets, you coat the meat with bread crumbs.

examples.ko: 빵가루가 없으면 식빵을 갈아서 써도 돼요.
examples.en: If you don't have bread crumbs, you can grind sandwich bread and use that.

examples.ko: 생선에 밀가루, 달걀, 빵가루 순서로 입혀 주세요.
examples.en: Please coat the fish with flour, egg, then bread crumbs in that order.

examples.ko: 빵가루는 기름에 튀기면 금방 갈색이 돼요.
examples.en: Bread crumbs turn brown quickly when fried in oil.

examples.ko: 장 보러 가서 달걀하고 빵가루도 샀어요.
examples.en: I went grocery shopping and bought eggs and bread crumbs too.

examples.ko: 빵가루 옷이 두꺼워서 안에 고기가 별로 없어요.
examples.en: The breading is so thick that there's hardly any meat inside.

explain: 돈가스나 튀김의 겉에 입히는 가루예요. '튀김옷'과 같이 알아 두면 좋고, '빵가루를 묻히다, 빵가루를 입히다'처럼 말해요.

phrases.example: 새우에 밀가루와 달걀, 빵가루를 차례로 묻혀요.
phrases.en: I coat the shrimp with flour, egg, and then bread crumbs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 튀기기 전에 재료 겉에 가루를 붙이는 동작을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes coating the outside of an ingredient before frying.

phrases.en: I coated the fish with bread crumbs and fried it.
phrases.nuance_ko: '묻히다'와 비슷하고, 겉옷을 입히듯 감싸는 느낌이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar to 묻히다, with a feel of covering the food like clothing.

phrases.en: I sprinkle bread crumbs on top of the gratin and bake it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 음식 위에 가루를 솔솔 뿌릴 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when sprinkling crumbs lightly over food.

explain_en: It is the crumb coating put on pork cutlets and fried foods. It is good to learn it with '튀김옷' (batter coating), and you say '빵가루를 묻히다' or '빵가루를 입히다'.

en: to be refreshing; to be fresh; to be tangy

examples.en: Lemon tea has a fresh, zesty taste.
The morning air is fresh, so I feel good.
I bought soap that has a fresh scent.
The outfit you're wearing today looks so fresh.

examples.ko: 느끼한 음식 뒤에는 상큼한 과일을 먹어요.
examples.en: After greasy food, I eat fresh, zesty fruit.
That child's smile is bright and cute.

explain: 신맛이 살짝 나는 과일, 향, 공기, 옷차림처럼 기분 좋게 산뜻한 것에 써요. '신선하다'는 오래되지 않았다는 뜻이고, '상큼하다'는 맛이나 느낌이 가볍고 깨끗하다는 뜻이에요. 특히 귤, 레몬, 딸기 같은 맛에 잘 써요.

phrases.en: This soap has a fresh scent.
phrases.nuance_ko: 레몬이나 오렌지처럼 산뜻한 향에 잘 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits light, clean scents like lemon or orange.

phrases.en: The clothes you're wearing today look fresh.
phrases.nuance_ko: 옷차림이나 얼굴이 산뜻하고 기분 좋아 보일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when an outfit or face looks light and pleasant.

phrases.en: This juice isn't very refreshing.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기대한 산뜻한 느낌이 없을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the expected fresh feeling is missing.

explain_en: Spoken; light fresh taste or scent, like lemon or citrus. It fits pleasantly light things such as slightly tart fruit, scents, air, and outfits. 신선하다 says something is not stale, whereas 상큼하다 describes a light, clean taste or feeling. It is especially common for citrus and strawberries.

t90.ax: Lemon tea has a fresh, zesty taste.

en: to taste; to sample; to try food

examples.en: A customer tried a sample of the new bread.
I tried a sample of the beef at the mart and bought it.

examples.ko: 먼저 시식하신 분이 맛을 말해 주세요.
examples.en: Whoever tasted it first, please tell us how it is.
I chose by sampling several kinds of kimchi.
The staff member gave me a small cup to sample.

examples.ko: 아이들은 시식할 수 있는 코너를 제일 좋아해요.
examples.en: Kids like the corner where they can sample food best.

explain: 마트나 가게에서 사기 전에 조금 먹어 보는 상황에 어울려요. 집에서 요리 맛을 보는 건 '맛보다'나 '간을 보다'라고 해요. 그냥 먹는 것은 '먹다'예요.

phrases.en: Please try a sample of this cheese.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가게에서 손님에게 먹어 보라고 권할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: What a shop says when inviting a customer to try a sample.

phrases.en: I tasted the soup to see if it was salty.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어디서든 쓸 수 있는 말이에요. 집에서 요리 맛을 볼 때도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Works anywhere, including tasting your own cooking at home.

phrases.en: I decided to taste it first and then buy.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사기 전에 먹어 보는 순서를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes tasting first and buying afterward.

explain_en: Sampling food at a store or event before buying (소시지 시식) It fits the situation of eating a little before buying at a mart or shop. Checking the taste of your own cooking at home is '맛보다' or '간을 보다'. Just eating is '먹다'.

t90.ax: A customer tried a sample of the new bread.
